blocks.text: Filipino-German actress-model Daniela Straner, actor Allen Ansay, dancer Lorelaine Sañosa, and athlete Ronnie Pasamba are the new housemates at the “Pinoy Big Brother: Collab Edition 3.0” following the first eviction night, which saw two contestants leave the reality show. Stranner, Ansay, Sañosa, and Pasamba officially entered the Bahay ni Kuya on Sunday, Nov. 15. Stranner and Sañosa joined the Kapamilya team, while Ansay and Pasamba became part of the Kapuso group. Their arrival came a day after Ethan Benares and Calix Esguerra became the first evictees of the season. During Saturday’s eviction night, Benares received 28.7% of the votes to save, […]...
